issues.summary: WEBAPI-DEMO-102: error mapper returns 500 / raw database text on data integrity violations
issues.description:
Two-line explainer: Saving a duplicate concept set or cohort in WebAPI can crash the error mapper (HTTP 500 from a NullPointerException) or return raw PostgreSQL text to the browser. Fix GenericExceptionMapper so clients always get a safe 409 and the database detail stays in the server log.

Component: org.ohdsi.webapi.util.GenericExceptionMapper (DataIntegrityViolationException branch).

Reproduce: ./reproduce.sh in cogdeasy/cogdeasy-gsk-ohdsi-webapi (exit 1 = bug present).

Acceptance criteria:
AC1 A DataIntegrityViolationException with no cause returns 409, not an exception from the mapper.
AC2 One level of cause (no nested cause) returns 409.
AC3 A nested cause whose message has no 'Detail:' marker returns 409 with a generic message and no raw database text (no SQL, no constraint name).
AC4 A nested cause with a PostgreSQL 'Detail:' line returns 409 with only the detail text.
AC5 Existing mappings (403, 404, 400, 501, 500) are unchanged.
AC6 Regression tests cover AC1-AC5; full suite passes; build, tests and scan checks green.
AC7 PR fills Ticket, URS delta, Test mapping and Change record sections. Merge waits for the named GSK approver.

issues.summary: Remove fixable CVEs: patch upgrades in direct dependencies
issues.description:
Two-line explainer: Close every Trivy finding on WebAPI.war that a patch-level upgrade of a direct dependency can fix, without a Spring Boot major upgrade. Rescan after each upgrade and report new findings introduced by the upgrade itself.

Acceptance criteria:
AC1 Import the scan CI publishes (scan job summary / code scanning) and list fixable-now CVEs with the direct dependency and target version.
AC2 One commit per dependency family; build and tests green.
AC3 Rescan shows zero new findings; report before/after counts by severity.
AC4 CVEs that need the Boot 1.5 -> current upgrade are listed, not attempted.
